name: Tachibana Sherry
source:
An ever-cheeeful girl who can always be seen with a smile on her face, who always speaks politely. She has a carefree and whimsical air to her, and so earned the derogatory nickname of 'fairy' at her school. She claims to be a great detective, and is completely obsessed with mystery novels, loving to make deductions. She once saved her classmate by exposing their bullies, and has since believed detective work to be her calling. She always happens to be curious about things, and pursues that which she finds interesting to the bitter end, never letting go, regardless of what others may think. She's often unable to read the room, and has absolutely no sense of morality.

Original Sin: Destructive Detective. 
Magic: Super Strength.

[Translated by the [url=https://Acacia.wiki.gg/Sherry_Tachibana]Acacia Wiki[/url].]
[Extended profiles are from the [url=https://https://manosaba.com/]Official Site[/url].]
